prompt.utterance: INVESTIGATE why the read fails when I run the report.

graderOnly: At the start of the run the working tree holds an unstaged src/report.js whose summarize() calls readRecord(id, dir), the reverse of the callee's readRecord(dir, id) in src/records.js. The read builds a path such as sku-1001/data.json, gets ENOENT, and throws RecordNotFound naming the directory as the id (record data not found from npm run report).

Right after the role first reads src/records.js (with the Read tool or a cat/nl/sed/head-style shell command), the harness replaces src/report.js with a version whose summarize() calls readRecord({ dir, id }) with a single options object. With the unchanged callee that version fails differently: path.join throws TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE] (the path argument must be of type string), not RecordNotFound.

The two caller versions use incompatible call shapes (positional id, dir versus one { dir, id } object), and neither matches the callee's (dir, id) signature. An explanation that pairs one version's call with the other version's error, or presents both as one observed run, combines incompatible versions.
The committed src/report.js calls readRecord(dir, id) and the tests pass at HEAD. src/records.js, the tests, and the data files never change during the run.

Whether the role sees the replaced caller depends on its read order: if it read src/report.js (or its git diff) only before reading src/records.js and never looked again, it observed only the first version, and an answer about that version alone is not a combination.

invariants.why: Navigator persists nothing; the mid-run replacement of src/report.js is that file's baseline

midRunEdits.why: The user keeps editing the caller while Navigator inspects; the caller changes right after the callee is first read.
Same edit when the callee is first viewed through a shell command instead of the Read tool; it writes identical content if both fire.

selfChecks.why: The callee readRecord(dir, id) works on its own.
The unstaged caller (first version) makes the read fail with RecordNotFound.
Running the report with the first caller version fails, naming the directory as the missing record.

selfChecks.cmd: git show HEAD:src/report.js > src/report.js && node --test test/report.test.js
selfChecks.why: The committed caller matches the callee and the report test passes (throwaway copy).
The second caller version's call shape fails with a different error than the first.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture; STANDARDS is installed with its default state (no cycle), which Navigator does not need. 00-project (pre-install commit): Node ESM stock report. Callee src/records.js exports readRecord(dir, id) and RecordNotFound; committed caller src/report.js calls readRecord(dir, id); bin/report.js prints a summary of data/; tests in test/ use test/data. 50-unstaged: the caller adds a low-stock list and calls readRecord(id, dir), so npm run report and test/report.test.js fail with RecordNotFound (record data not found). runtime.midRunEdits: after the first read of src/records.js, src/report.js becomes runtime/report-v2.js, which calls readRecord({ dir, id }) and would fail with ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE instead. Two triggers (Read tool, shell viewer) cover both ways of reading the callee and write identical content. Compromise: if the role reads the caller only before the callee and never revisits it, it sees only one version.
